title: AuditableItemGraphPartialVertex
description:
Partial vertex payload for updatePartial.
Sub-lists use explicit `{ add, remove }` patches; bare arrays are not supported.

id.description: The id of the vertex to update.

allOf.description: Interface describing an auditable item graph vertex.

dateCreated.description: The date/time of when the element was created.

dateModified.description: The date/time of when the element was modified.

dateDeleted.description: The date/time of when the element was deleted, as we never actually remove items.

organizationIdentity.description: The identity of the organization which controls the vertex.

auditMode.description:
How the mutations of the vertex are recorded, when absent the vertex behaves as audited.
Once a vertex is set to bypass it can not be returned to audited.

annotationObject.description: The JSON-LD annotation object for the vertex.

verified.description:
Is the vertex verified, will only be populated when verification is requested.
Always undefined when the vertex is in bypass mode.

version.description:
The version of the vertex, populated only when getting a specific version.
Always undefined when the vertex is in bypass mode.
Maps to https://schema.org/version.

allOf.$comment: Inlined utility base type AuditableItemGraphVertex so utility transformations can operate on concrete properties instead of a $ref.
